branches.name: project-integrity-refactor
branches.reason: The branch introduced a project-integrity architecture that is now present and materially evolved on main: central project identity, programme-control lifecycle registry, generated publication-scope reporting, repository integrity validation and PR validation. Current main carries the same mechanisms under current Ovid’s House authority, with later maturity/public-surface/nomenclature controls. publication/scope-report.ts is byte-identical to the branch version; the other core mechanisms are clear descendants or deliberate successors rather than stranded work.

branches.name: public-url-phase-1
branches.reason: The branch's clean-public-URL and route-validation system is present and evolved on main. Current project/site-routes.ts retains the branch's source-ID rewriting, public route mapping, Markdown link rewriting and navigation/sidebar mapping, while adding explicit public-surface awareness and repository-source fallback for intentionally hidden records. Current scripts/validate-public-routes.ts retains collision, route-contract and navigation coverage checks while restricting validation to the resolved public surface. There is no useful branch-only residue to salvage.
